stages.name: source integrity and component consistency
stages.ready_work: Replay existing genuinely acquired packets and real bounded native examples; pin complete new-run conventions; descriptive residuals only where historical conventions are missing
stages.numeric_targets: SRS inertia relative 1e-10 for well-conditioned same-input numerical kernel; exact source bytes/tokens; displayed historical energy residual without fabricated acceptance threshold
stages.risks: Small residual may be mistaken for exact method identity or uncertainty

stages.name: development-only convergence and cost pilot
stages.ready_work: Once exact energy/derivative tuple is genuinely implemented and verified, run water/formaldehyde plus explicitly supported development cases; record tightened tolerances, grids, basis/nuclear-motion sensitivity and true budgets
stages.numeric_targets: Candidate 1 kHz maximum line change under each final numerical tightening, derived as 1% of the proposed 100 kHz resolution; source and physics prerequisites apply
stages.pros: Separates solver/discretization error from model error and exposes cost
stages.cons: Higher derivatives can require thousands of primitive calls; pilot cannot validate held-out accuracy
stages.risks: Sensitivity plateaus do not prove unbiased physical model or complete resonant VPT2

stages.name: bounded prospective family-held-out physical comparison
stages.ready_work: Curate primary measurement sources; freeze named recipes and v2 split; seal predictions before held-out scoring; score all intended cases and failures without coverage certification
stages.numeric_targets: Proposed 100 kHz line-position use-case target with measured source uncertainty at most 10 kHz and numerical variation at most 1 kHz; all assumptions must be accepted/frozen before evaluation
stages.pros: Defensible named-domain error assessment and reproducible publication record
stages.cons: Initial one calibration family and two held-out families are much too small for calibrated transfer coverage
stages.risks: Target may be unattainable by de novo profile; only prospective frozen amendments may alter it; matching frequency alone is insufficient identification

stages.name: identification and uncertainty qualification
stages.ready_work: Separate preregistered real spectral challenge set with competitors, negative controls, instrument response/population metadata and adequate independent groups; all physics stages must genuinely exist
stages.numeric_targets: Target 95% family-level coverage is a candidate nominal level only. Initial campaign produces no finite conformal interval or scientific coverage claim. Frequency tolerance derives from instrument/linewidth and false-assignment study
stages.pros: Tests the practical identification claim and uncertainty instead of constants alone
stages.cons: Substantially more primary-source and independent group curation; not scheduled by existing resource budget
stages.risks: Spectral confusion, group dependence and chemical transfer invalidate unsupported calibrated claims

numerical_kernel_rotational_relative.basis: existing SRS V-ROT; same masses/geometry/units, well-conditioned inertia; not experimental accuracy

instrument_resolution_assumption.status: hypothetical instrument use-case; no hardware asserted
instrument_resolution_assumption.meaning: absolute line-frequency resolution after stated channelization, instrumental calibration, line-centre extraction and Doppler/pressure treatment

numerical_tightening_line_change_kHz.basis: 1% of proposed resolution; budget allocation rather than published universal molecular accuracy

physical_line_position_absolute_residual.basis: proposed ability to place a line within one 100 kHz resolution element; all frozen selected measured lines, no average-error escape

constant_component_MHz_targets.derivation: Compute sensitivities of the qualified selected Hamiltonian to A/B/C, distortion and hyperfine parameters. Fix per-axis engineering allocations through |J delta p| in the specified line domain before held-out evaluation; do not infer a universal percent or ignore correlated constants.

candidate_targets.relative_intensity_reason: No real line-intensity calibration, temperatures, spin populations or response uncertainty acquired. Dipole-derived catalogue intensities are predictions, not primary measurements.
candidate_targets.discovery_search_window_reason: Must be justified prospectively by measured spectral density/competitor frequencies and development results; no invented universal +/- MHz window

pin_before_run: atomic isotope masses and constants release
force-field displacement stencil and actual step sizes
resonance thresholds and actual diagonalization space
convergence_protocol.derivative_validation: Analytic/response derivatives require independent matched finite differences at several actual step sizes, translational/rotational covariance and actual solver-state continuity; calibrate truncation versus roundoff/convergence on development cases. Never use response-incomplete sums as exact revDSD.
convergence_protocol.vibrational_sign: delta_B_vib = B0 - Be; B0 prediction adds actual qualified correction; Be_SE = B0_exp - delta_B_vib_calc is separately anchored Product B
convergence_protocol.same_model_repeat: Tighten SCF/grid/geometry/resonance/basis-discretization controls separately as permitted by pinned model; a basis or electronic model change is declared model sensitivity, not a pure solver convergence check
convergence_protocol.missing_property: Plan identifiable additional actual calculation with cost and typed provenance; retain earlier valid stages, no B0 or fundamental frequency substitute

source_policies.QM9: Original CC0 source and computational metadata are usable as theory-source/parser/development evidence. Unknown B3LYP variant/grid/mass/engine/version prevent an exact same-model numerical acceptance threshold. Harmonic omega is not an observed fundamental; U0 is not pure electronic energy. All 20 retained members and related families are inspected development/excluded data.
source_policies.Piccardo2015_secondary_B0: Six printed secondary experimental constants are descriptive/source extraction evidence only until primary article identity, isotope/state/Hamiltonian and uncertainty convention are reconciled. Current uncertainty null. Same source/family dependence preserved.
source_policies.primary_experiment: Require authentic original measured/fitted-data bytes and explicit molecule/isotope/state/units/assignment/Hamiltonian origin. Resolve original bibliography and fitted covariance/confidence. Distinguish fitted constants from raw measured lines and fit-predicted catalogue entries.
source_policies.NIST_WebBook_CCCBDB: Agent retrieves original entries and cited papers after actual access succeeds; electronic/rovibrational/statistical convention and reported reference version pinned; thermochemical values do not validate line identification.
source_policies.JPL_CDMS_HITRAN: Catalogue predictions and data reformatting do not become independent observations. Follow measurement bibliography, reproduce quantum-number/uncertainty-code interpretation, keep release and permissions; primary fitted lines and anchor overlap determine eligibility.
source_policies.QCArchive: Live record provenance/full engine settings/basis/geometry required for exact computational comparison; historical captured NH3 remains component evidence only. QCSchema is interchange format, not source authorship/database or accuracy certificate.

blinding_and_grouping.unit: chemical family, joined conservatively by source-dependence graph; never line/axis/isotopologue count
blinding_and_grouping.carbonyl_rule: All inspected QM9 carbonyl classes and any declared related carbonyl class remain development/excluded; ketene is not silently retained as held-out after a broad carbonyl grouping
blinding_and_grouping.fluoride_rule: Carbon fluorides and heteroatomic fluorides are proposed separate chemical families, not a verified exchangeable population. If scientific review merges them into one broader fluoride family, the complete joined family is calibration/development and held-out availability shrinks; never split it to preserve counts.
blinding_and_grouping.source_rule: Shared primary fit, shared measured lines, shared artifacts and transitive source bindings remain grouped. Copying/repacking one dataset cannot create independent groups. Separate underlying primary experiments may be documented honestly, never inferred from different file names.
blinding_and_grouping.prediction_seal: Immutable prediction and raw-artifact digests before scoring; source curation may see references, prediction tuning may not inspect prospective held-out residuals. No claim of enforced access isolation is made by this proposal alone.
blinding_and_grouping.inspected_case_rule: Inspected physical held-out values/residuals move affected complete family to development in a versioned future campaign; maintain original trial outcome rather than erasing it

metrics_and_failure_policy.residual: prediction minus reference; relative residual divided by absolute(reference) for the descriptive comparison client. Use the campaign implementation documented signed denominator consistently; values here are positive constants/frequencies.
reports: observed source uncertainty and covariance status
metrics_and_failure_policy.failures: All preregistered intended eligible cases stay in the denominator; missing physics is failed/blocked/incomplete, never zero residual or pass. Exclusions depend only on frozen identity/source/physics criteria, never error magnitude.
metrics_and_failure_policy.unknown_uncertainty: Keep null; report unweighted descriptive values where identity permits, but no standardized score, invented covariance or confidence interval

finite_sample_limits.split_conformal_rule: k = ceil((n + 1)*0.95), kth exact family-group score; if k>n, finite threshold unavailable
finite_sample_limits.exchangeability: Calibration carbon-fluoride family versus different nitrogen-oxide/heterofluoride families is not an established exchangeable sample; no theorem transfers a finite order statistic to this chemistry automatically.

empirical_illustration.conditions: All59 successes of prespecified iid/exchangeable Bernoulli group coverage; illustrates scale only, not a sufficiency rule or assertion such groups exist; selection/dependence/transfer invalidate that interpretation
